run_coconut_training: run distributed training of a Coconut model on a math reasoning dataset using a YAML config file
run_coconut_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained Coconut model on a validation set to measure answer accuracy and CoT match
resume_coconut_training: resume a preempted Coconut training run from the latest saved checkpoint automatically
wrap_model_with_coconut: wrap a pretrained causal language model with the Coconut wrapper to enable latent reasoning tokens
save_coconut_checkpoint: save a Coconut model checkpoint after each epoch or only when validation accuracy improves
